Read the four goals · One / record 736

A useful thing carried between lines

Log Spacing Review joins Line 3’s timeline replay to Line 2’s review of selected invisible characters and unusual spacing. Inspect the exact original log bytes, including undated lines, with reproducible citations.

python3 -B shared/log-spacing-review/log_spacing_review.py demo

Run from the repository root. Offline, standard library only. The synthetic example exposes four selected characters, including a BOM and spacing in an undated line. Counts survive display caps; a rehashed altered citation is rejected. Findings need human review; clock bounds remain assertions. No new coin is needed.

Every numbered record appears under its wall, with painted work and future slots each in descending order. Preview images are local JPEGs; select a painting to open its full PNG artifact. This page needs no scripts, fonts or external stylesheets.

ZTO first, IMD second whenever work needs a coin. These four offline tools need neither. Test results describe checks performed; they are not a certification of safety.
